fights.display: Ian Machado Garry vs Islam Makhachev

cappers.name: Funkybunch MMA
cappers.reasoning: Calls Makhachev the last remaining lock and the GOAT; says Garry is a pillow puncher who won't knock him out, and Makhachev's grappling strength is something Garry has never faced, so it's just a question of submission or decision.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: Leg two of the Slam of the Week: calls Makhachev the best fighter in the world, 29-1, still in his prime with undiminished athleticism and a better chin at 170, while Garry can't finish anything.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Garry can't close the wrestling gap in a couple years of training; Makhachev's smash wrestling and control should dominate, though he doesn't expect a finish.

cappers.name: Left Lane MMA
cappers.reasoning: Expects Makhachev's superior trip/body-lock takedown arsenal (like Shavkat's success late) to control Garry to a 49-46/48-47 decision, though Garry's takedown defense and range make it tougher than the JDM fight.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: He's clearly backing Islam ('we can't lose... let's get the win'), saying the face-off made him more confident because Islam looked noticeably bigger and stronger while Garry looked flimsy, and that once Islam gets him to the ground it's going to be a problem; he laments the -400 price being long.

cappers.name: MMA Husky Hustler
cappers.reasoning: Garry will have success at range, but over five rounds Makhachev's adaptability and constant grappling threats should take over, and extended top time makes it hard for Garry to recover.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev's wrestling and pressure are too much; Garry won't stop the takedowns and Makhachev's striking is good enough to hold his own.

cappers.name: Bedtime MMA
cappers.reasoning: He says he's leaning with Makhachev and can't pick against him — underrated boxing, elite defensive striking, and by far the better wrestler/grappler, though he acknowledges a Garry head-kick KO is the main upset path.

cappers.name: Locked Door MMA
cappers.reasoning: Despite Garry's length and footwork, Makhachev is a good enough grappler to get him down and control him like he did to Della Maddalena.

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Says he's picking Islam now, partly because Belal (who Garry beat) has looked washed and Garry hasn't shown the wrestling threat; also rates Makhachev's boxing and resume highly.

cappers.name: MMA AL DENTE
cappers.reasoning: Already bet Garry, preferring the moneyline to the decision prop; he thinks Garry frustrates Islam at range, welterweight physicality blunts the grappling, and Garry has 25 minutes of cardio.

cappers.name: Young Pastey
cappers.reasoning: Garry is the bigger man with a reach advantage in a bigger octagon, and Pastey doesn't believe Makhachev can hold prolonged top control on him; if it's a striking match Garry's point fighting wins.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Nick believes Garry is underrated, has the cleaner striking, will be well prepared and the takedowns won't come easily, making the fight much closer than the price indicates.

cappers.name: THE MMA GURU
cappers.reasoning: Garry's height, reach and back-foot movement mean he won't give Makhachev his hips like JDM did, the cage helps his takedown defense, and Makhachev's forward-moving striking defense is poor.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Sees too much value at +275 on a smart, rangy true welterweight with improved takedown defense; admits Makhachev is the smart pick but takes Garry to win a decision.

options.selection: Islam Makhachev by submission in round 4

cappers.name: TonyHasDiedMMA
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev has solved every advantage Garry has before (size, reach, boxing), is elite in scrambles with the d'arce and back takes, and Garry can't finish him or out-decision him with Khabib game-planning.

cappers.name: TheWeasle
cappers.reasoning: Makhachev's elite sambo/judo grappling, improving striking and IQ, plus reportedly 11 lbs of added muscle making him heavier than Garry on fight night, means Garry is in trouble once grabbed.

cappers.name: BetSlam with Sam
cappers.reasoning: They believe if Makhachev finishes it's by submission (arm triangle), likely within three rounds, since Garry is ineffective off his back.

cappers.name: Let's Talk MMA (Colby)
cappers.reasoning: They don't see Garry surviving 25 minutes; Makhachev will get it to the ground, wear him out with his weight and find the sub later in the fight (rounds three through five), with Garry also seen as distracted.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Nobody defends Makhachev's takedowns and Garry lacks one-punch power, so Garry would have to win a decision; Makhachev drags him late for a finish.

cappers.name: MMA BG
cappers.reasoning: Vega sees value at +230 in a five-round fight because Garry gasses in later rounds and Islam's grappling is a level above; he expects a round three or four submission.

cappers.name: KennyOkoyeMMA
cappers.reasoning: He sees Islam having a field day controlling Garry on his back and finishing him thanks to Garry's long limbs and long neck, calling submission a very high probability.

cappers.name: MMA Prediction Guru
cappers.reasoning: Garry will get backed up and put on the fence; Makhachev's superior cage wrestling, top control and back takes should win him three of five rounds in a close fight.

cappers.name: MMA OddsBreaker (Adam)
cappers.reasoning: Adam calls it an easy pick he isn't questioning: Garry's takedown defense won't hold up over five rounds, similar to the Shavkat fight, so Makhachev grinds out a decision.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night

cappers.name: Bedtime MMA
cappers.reasoning: Garry may win the early rounds striking, but his takedown defense on open-mat singles/doubles is questionable and Makhachev's wrestling and control will accumulate for a 48-47 or 49-46 decision.

cappers.name: MMA BG

cappers.name: MMA AL DENTE

cappers.name: Young Pastey
